description: Defines the DistEngine class responsible for managing distributed autograd backward passes, including execution, dependency computation, and cleanup within the PyTorch distributed autograd framework.

classes.name: DistEngine
classes.description: Singleton class managing distributed autograd backward passes, dependencies, and cleanup.

classes.name: BackwardPassCleanupGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for cleaning up resources after backward pass completion.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DistEngine.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts distributed backward pass from root variables, accumulating gradients.

methods.name: executeSendFunctionAsync
methods.description: Executes a send function asynchronously within the autograd engine, managing dependencies.

methods.name: numBackwardPasses
methods.description: Returns the current number of active backward passes.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debugging info related to distributed autograd.

methods.name: validateRootsAndRetrieveEdges
methods.description: Validates root variables and retrieves gradient edges.

methods.name: computeDependencies
methods.description: Computes autograd dependencies for the local node.

methods.name: execute_graph_task_until_ready_queue_empty
methods.description: Executes the autograd graph until the ready queue is empty.

methods.name: runEngineAndAccumulateGradients
methods.description: Runs the autograd engine and accumulates gradients.

methods.name: cleanupBackwardPass
methods.description: Cleans up resources after backward pass.

methods.name: globalCpuThread
methods.description: Thread function for executing CPU continuations.
